StrictDocStarter sample specifications

The four Markdown samples that ship with StrictDocStarter, exported by StrictDoc and published as browsable requirement trees.

StrictDocStarter 同梱の Markdown サンプル 4 件を、StrictDoc で書き出して 公開しています。

Start here / まずこちら

  • md-basic-endefault

    The smallest set that still works as a requirements specification: upper requirements, lower ones that point at them, test cases that verify those, and review status carried on the requirements themselves. Copy this folder to start your own. English.

  • md-basic-ja

    同じ仕様書の日本語版。上位要求・下位要求・テストケース・レビュー欄を それぞれ別ファイルに置き、トレーサビリティがファイルをまたぐように してあります。自分の仕様書はこれを丸ごと写して始めてください。

A full-size example / 本格的な例

  • md-sovd-automotive-en

    A complete SOVD (Service-Oriented Vehicle Diagnostics; ASAM SOVD / ISO 17978) specification: 122 requirements across 21 documents, with EARS requirement text, Gherkin tests, ASIL and A-SPICE custom fields, Mermaid diagrams, math, and traceability from requirement through design and API to test result. English.

  • md-sovd-automotive-ja

    同じ SOVD 仕様書の日本語版。要求 122 件・21 文書。ノード数も関係の 本数も英語版と 1 件残らず一致します。

Reading the pages

Each project has its own left toolbar: the document tree, a traceability matrix, a tree map and project statistics. Requirement identifiers are links - follow one to see what it derives from and what verifies it.

Generated by StrictDoc 0.27.1 and rebuilt from the repository on every change to the samples. The two language editions of each sample deliberately share their requirement identifiers, so they are exported as separate projects.
